name: satellites-hexagon-recovery-memo.pdf
description: A 1972 HEXAGON memo and attachments detailing the July 1971 loss, October 1971 location, and 1972 Trieste II deep-sea recovery attempts for reconnaissance recovery vehicle RV-3 (lost at about 16,000 ft after a parachute failure), including the partial film recovery and lessons learned.

metadata.title: Deep Sea Recovery of HEXAGON RV 1201-3
